description: Source code implementing platform service management functions for the Cobalt project, including registration, opening, closing, and sending messages for platform services, with conditional handling for Evergreen builds.

classes.name: CobaltExtensionPlatformService
classes.description: Opaque handle representing a platform service instance.

classes.name: CobaltExtensionPlatformServicePrivate
classes.description: Implementation class for platform service, managing service details and API.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a service name is registered in the platform service registry.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a platform service by name, creating and returning a service handle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a platform service handle.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data through the platform service.

methods.name: GetPlatformServiceApi
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the platform service API structure.
